title: Saga-driven model lifecycle with condensed canary and rewind oracle
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: We need a compact, auditable model lifecycle flow for short-lived canaries and automated rewind suggestions when signals diverge. Large staged rollouts are costly for small model tweaks (quantization, tokenization changes) and slow feedback loops increase mean time to remediation. This PR introduces a Saga-pattern rollout controller that coordinates: (1) condensed canary windows (fast 3-step ramps with smokechecks), (2) shadow-to-canary promotion heuristics, (3) a lightweight rewind-oracle that recommends rollback points based on multivariate telemetry and causal checks, and (4) an audit journal for replayable rollback and postmortem. Summary of changes: - New controller: rollout/saga_controller.go (.go) implementing stepwise saga coordination and compensating actions for failed steps. - Condensed policy: config/rollouts/condensed_canary.yaml -- default 3-stage policy (0.5%, 10%, 50%) with smokecheck thresholds and minimum observation windows. - Rewind oracle: tools/rewind_oracle/score.py -- Python scoring service that ingests telemetry snapshots and outputs ranked rewind candidates and confidence. - Telemetry hooks: runtime/telemetry/telemetry_hooks.go adds enriched context tags (model_version, cohort_hint, saga_id). - Audit journal: persistence/journal/rollout_journal.proto + journal writer and a compact JSON exporter for replay tests. - E2E test harness updates: test/harness/condensed_canary_test.py with synthetic smoke scenarios and failure injections. - Docs: docs/runbooks/condensed_canary.md and API swagger additions for new rollout endpoints. Checklist: - [x] Implementation of saga coordinator with compensating ops - [x] Unit tests for controller state transitions - [x] Integration tests for condensed canary ramp and rollback path - [x] Rewind oracle basic scoring and CLI exporter - [x] Updated telemetry + tracing spans for easy correlation - [x] Runbook and rollout playbook drafted in docs Breaking changes: none. Backwards compatibility: existing rollout policies remain supported; condensed policy is opt-in. Commits (high level): - feat(saga): add saga coordinator and state machine - feat(rewind): initial rewind oracle scoring service and CLI - perf(telemetry): add enriched tags and bulk export path - test(harness): add condensed canary e2e scenarios - docs: runbook and swagger updates Testing & Validation: - Unit: added 48 unit tests across controller and telemetry; CI passes locally. - Integration: CI runs condensed_canary_test against local dev runtime; smokecheck asserts triggered for injected latency/failure patterns. - Chaos: one CI job runs failure-injection path to validate compensating transactions. Rollout Plan: 1) Deploy rewind_oracle as internal canary service in staging. 2) Deploy saga_controller in canary mode (no automatic promote) for one week to collect signals. 3) Enable condensed_canary policy opt-in for a small set of customers (cohort tag). 4) After 72 hours of stable telemetry, flip auto-promote to enabled. 5) Monitor rewind_oracle recommendations and SLOs; keep manual override for first month. Related: ENG-2345 (condensed canary design), ENG-2410 (rewind score algorithm). Release notes: "Introduce saga-driven condensed canary controller with rewind-oracle to accelerate short-lived model rollouts; opt-in condensed policy and audit journal for replayable rollbacks."
